blind.second_guess: stone pillar or small guard tower
blind.description: A square stone masonry chimney stack or pillar featuring rough-hewn stone blocks set in mortar. A projecting stone ledge/cornice tops the shaft, surmounted by corner stone blocks framing an open center, capped by an inverted-V shaped gable roof hood made of greenish-slate stone or weathered copper/slate. Surfaces are fully solid, stylized low-poly/hand-painted geometry with clean, closed meshes. Sits flat directly on the floor with no extra pedestal or ground slab.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square stone perimeter with a rectangular teal/greenish pitched roof ridge running horizontally across the center, revealing dark openings underneath on either side.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (the interior of the chimney flue is dark sooty black/charcoal as appropriate)
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide at the base.
